description: High-volatility continuous autotrain hill-climb policy. Harness/driver code loads this artifact; change metrics, cadence, caps, and identity fields here without re-authoring classifiers. Dual-regime thrash: isolate (causal OFAT) + climb (residual on sticky champion) + timeout→decode residual routing.

screening_sample_size.description: screening_smoke_n is the fail-closed fallback only. In auto mode the loop computes the certified range per cycle (screening_sample_size/v1): exact sign-test decidability floor at power_gate.alpha (bound.screening_n.decidability_lower.v1), budget ceiling from the arm wall (bound.screening_n.budget_upper.v1), and the smoke-suite volume ceiling. Feasible range -> climb at n_min; infeasible -> fallback n with a typed binding-constraints verdict, never a silent fixture screen.

latency_probe.description: Per-arm latency pre-check (screening only): a probe eval of probe_records records runs before the full eval under a -latprobe run id. The full eval is skipped with a typed latency_preflight verdict (measurement incomplete, never a model verdict) when the probe projects past the remaining eval wall (probe_wall x planned_n, planned_n = resolved screening n); a probe timeout stops the arm at one record instead of n. Probe metrics never merge into arm metrics.

thrash_timing.description: Pareto-calibrated thrash budgets: timeouts ≈ p95(work)+margin. Incomplete rate outside [low,high] means recalculate recipe/budget, not ad-hoc wall++.

thrash_regimes.description: Isolate = causal OFAT vs zeroed/precursor control. Climb = residual thrash on sticky confirmed/climb_accepted champion knobs. Timeout residual prefers decode-cost arms when prior cycle was incomplete with compiler_ms-dominant decode timeout. Confirm/promote freeze thrash.

screening_arm_closure.description: Permanent thrash-arm bank close requires this many distinct seeds of complete non-positive measurement. One fixture-noise null never closes the approach.

screening_saturation.description: After 15 consecutive complete primary ties, stop normal bank selection and spend one fresh seed on each of the two best size-matched absolute-quality regimes. Incompletes are skipped, a complete non-tie resets the streak, and decode-cost regimes must clear the existing latency-effect floor.

selection.description: Deterministic evidence-ledger arm selection: per-arm conjugate NIG posterior over the primary-metric effect, ranked by mean + exploration_c posterior-sd upper confidence. Residual boosts stay lexicographically dominant. mode=rotation restores the legacy soft-rank path.

power_gate.description: Exact sign-test power floor: arm closure requires enough independent complete-null cycles that the pooled sign test over screening_smoke_n-document cycles could have rejected at alpha. Never lowers min_complete_null_seeds.

terminal.description: When the screening bank is exhausted, emit the typed regime_exhausted verdict and park the loop instead of synthesizing compose filler arms or burning confirm seeds. Causal-cap relaxation and retryable promote heads remain active (they are evidence-driven, not filler).

conclusion_policy.description: Hypothesis-family conclusion criteria (WP-4). A family (canonicalized sorted lever_keys) closes after this many adequately powered failures; a closed approach never closes a goal (AGENTS.md I14). Reopen on a lever key absent from the closing evidence or a changed harness component version. See docs/design/hypothesis-family-conclusions.md.
